_note: Backgrounds of the graph levels per visuals.json style (src/world/level_backdrop.gd, shaders cave_backdrop / earth_fill). Colours are hex. cave_*: underground back wall (band 1 = under the roots, band 2 = the deep); glow: fungi / root embers / ice crystals dotting it; glow_density 0..1 share of 90 px cells that hold one; crack: Navi cracks of the deep band. earth_*: the solid ground body: stone = pebbles, strata = layer lines, roots = root threads near the top. landmarks: silhouette kinds placed along the level, one per landmark_every layer px (layer scale landmark_scale), coloured landmark_col and faded toward the style fog by landmark_fog. progress_tint: colour the far layers drift toward by the level's end (progress_k = how far, 0..1). anchor_tween: seconds the surface backdrop takes to follow a room at another height. Optional art: cave_tex (a seamless PNG used as the far cave wall instead of the procedural one), earth_tex (a seamless PNG for the solid ground). cave_tex_scale / earth_tex_scale scale those images. landmark_halo: alpha of the fog glow behind a landmark. Art drop-in guide: assets/art/backgrounds/README.md. cave_fit_room: the painted cave scene (cave_tex far, cave_mid_tex arches) fits one module height (x cave_fit_rows) from each underground room's top. landmarks_off keeps the procedural silhouettes for a fallback; the painted mid layers carry the scenery now.
